acrobatics.critical_success: Daring Maneuver: Gain +30 to your next action for one round.
acrobatics.critical_failure: Catastrophic Tumble: Suffer d6 bludgeoning damage and become Prone.

athletics.critical_success: Herculean Feat: Next successful attack is a Critical Strike, or next door/container is smashed open automatically (whichever happens first).

dodge.critical_success: Elusive Maneuver: Gain +20 to Dodge for the next round.
dodge.critical_failure: Clumsy Misstep: Receive double damage from the source you were trying to avoid.

endurance.critical_success: Unwavering Resilience: Recover 1 Health and lose d4 Exhaustion.
endurance.critical_failure: Overwhelmed by Strain: Gain d4 Exhaustion.

initiative.critical_success: Snap Reaction: Perform your next attack with Advantage.
initiative.critical_failure: Taken by Surprise: Lose your first turn.

perception.critical_success: Heightened Awareness: Gain Advantage on your next Perception check.
perception.critical_failure: Blind Spot: Gain Disadvantage on your next Perception check.

reason.critical_success: Brilliant Deduction: Identify one possessed magic item without spending an Attunement Crystal.
reason.critical_failure: Mental Block: Increase the Lair/Domain Exit Die by 1 stage.

scavenge.critical_success: Good Find: Optionally add +5 to your Scavenging table roll.
scavenge.critical_failure: Noisy Search: Roll on the Combat Encounters table.

spellward.critical_success: Unbreakable Will: Become Resistant to magic damage for the next d4 rounds.
spellward.critical_failure: Magical Vulnerability: Take double spell damage, or spell consequences last twice as long.

stealth.critical_success: Ghost in the Shadows: If you attack in the next round, it strikes automatically.
stealth.critical_failure: Flimsy Footing: Gain Disadvantage on actions in the next round.

thievery.critical_success: Masterful Thief: Gain Advantage on your next Thievery check.
thievery.critical_failure: Bungled Attempt: Trigger a missed trap and roll on the Traps table.
